name: Policy Q&A Style Adapter
headline: Answer employee policy questions in a consistent compliant voice.
description: An instruction-SFT template for HR, IT, and InfoSec policy teams. Train a small model to answer free-form policy questions in a strict, citation-friendly style: short opening summary, the relevant policy clause, and a 'when in doubt, escalate to <team>' closer. Pattern fits HR helpdesks, security operations Slack bots, and compliance hotlines where consistency of voice matters as much as factual correctness.
suggested_brief: Train a policy Q&A assistant that answers in a fixed three-part style: (1) one-sentence summary, (2) the exact policy clause that applies, (3) escalation team. Tone: terse, neutral, no hedging. Cite the policy section by name in every answer.
